mission.goal: earn qualified design-partner review through an inspectable claim and release gap
mission.strategic_choice: The Rejection Rule Is the Product
mission.rejected_default: broad omnichannel launch, feature enumeration and unobserved pipeline language
mission.organic_growth_mechanic: contrarian operator truth + reusable four-line audit + permissioned counterexample loop + public stop/repair/continue receipt
mission.non_negotiable: No engagement pattern, model score or scheduler may publish, spend, change the approved claim or assert an outcome.

okr.objective: Make one zero-budget launch decision more inspectable and useful than a polished omnichannel plan.
key_results: 4/4 assets pass the source-hidden senior-editor gate with zero blocking claim defect
7/7 content jobs have unique platform purpose, named review owner and explicit decision rule
10/10 lifecycle nodes preserve replayable input/output/evidence bindings
0 external actions occur without the exact content-bound human approval
0 market, conversion, pipeline or revenue effect is claimed before observation

opponent_stress_tests.Adobe Journey Optimizer: Match cross-channel journey coherence while preserving clause-level evidence and a human release boundary across creative and decision objects.
opponent_stress_tests.Braze: Match event-triggered lifecycle responsiveness without converting sparse behavior into invasive personalization or automatic strategy mutation.
opponent_stress_tests.HubSpot: Match CRM and campaign usability for a small team while exposing provenance, rejected claims and causal uncertainty that a convenient dashboard can hide.
opponent_stress_tests.Salesforce Marketing Cloud: Match enterprise journey governance without forcing the zero-budget pre-PMF motion into heavyweight channel breadth or opaque automation.
opponent_stress_tests.Iterable: Match experimentation and cross-channel orchestration while binding every variant to the strategic hypothesis and exact release artifact.
opponent_stress_tests.Customer.io: Match flexible event-driven messaging while making consent, suppression, identity and stop rules first-class lifecycle states.
opponent_stress_tests.Klaviyo: Match revenue-oriented lifecycle segmentation without applying commerce assumptions or treating attributed pipeline as reconciled revenue.
opponent_stress_tests.Hightouch: Match warehouse-native activation while preventing freshness, identity resolution or audience sync from bypassing policy and human authority.
opponent_stress_tests.Clay: Match fast research-to-outreach composition while keeping source rights, enrichment boundaries and outbound claims inspectable.
opponent_stress_tests.Apollo: Match prospecting execution while requiring consent-aware audience logic, content-bound approval and measured incrementality before scale.

open_source_modifications.use: Typed Graph nodes and output contracts around the existing runtime.
Durable lifecycle state, retries, expiry, handoff and rollback semantics.
Held-out optimization of strategy and asset modules; scores cannot self-promote.
Narrow event and experiment observation adapter with explicit identity policy.
Preregistered experiment decisions and guardrails; never a causal shortcut.
Post-observation budget-response research only; inactive in the zero-budget candidate.
End-to-end input, asset, approval, observation and learning lineage.

truth_boundary: This lifecycle candidate binds real local draft artifacts and explicit zero-action decision contracts. It contains no publication, audience observation, human preference, named-product comparison, conversion, revenue, 4A or Top-1 proof.
